title: Coloured marks and clef forms
description: The `color` the schema allows on a key, an ending, a segno, a fine and a clef, each honoured on its own ink (green key signature, blue volta, red segno and fine, purple treble clef); and the clef properties the engine used to ignore: `octave: -1` with `showOctave: false` draws a plain treble clef that still sounds an octave down (MNX pitch is sounding, so the D4 and E4 are written a step above the middle line), the bass clef with `octave: -1` takes Bravura's fClef8vb, `octave: 2` in bar 2 takes gClef15ma, and an explicit `glyph` (fClefChange) is drawn as given. Nothing here is writable from the keyboard yet — colours have no verb, and `setClef` says neither `glyph` nor `showOctave` (core-measure-attributes-gaps.md, item 9).
